The function also fails to emit the Transfer event, which is a best practice for ERC20-compliant tokens as it provides a way for external systems to track token transfers. This could lead to a loss of confidence in the contract among potential users and investors, as they may be unable to verify the token's usage or the correctness of the implementation.
